clue.text: Before recess relative took a turn for the worse

definitions.text: took a turn for the worse

indicators.note: the word before tells us the relative is placed ahead of the recess in the answer

parts.note: an apse is a vaulted recess at the end of a church

explanation.surface: A family member's health declined just before a break.
explanation.definitionFit: To relapse is to fall back into illness after seeming to recover, a decline.

clue.text: Others with skill make a new beginning

parts.note: the rest means the others
art can mean skill, as in the art of conversation

explanation.surface: Other people with talent decide to start afresh.
explanation.definitionFit: To restart is to begin something again from the top.

clue.text: Connections to the golf course

definitions.meaning: a seaside golf course, as at St Andrews

explanation.definitionFit: Chain links join things together, and a coastal golf ground is called links.

clue.text: Earlier monastic dignitary

definitions.meaning: a senior monk, ranking just below an abbot

explanation.definitionFit: Prior is an adjective for previous and also the title of an officer in a religious house.

clue.text: Feature by articulate cockney egghead

indicators.note: articulate means spoken, and a cockney speaker drops the initial H of a word

parts.note: an egghead is an intellectual, a highbrow

explanation.surface: An expert is spoken about by an East Ender.
explanation.walkthrough: A cockney (a working-class Londoner) drops the H, so HIGHBROW comes out as 'IGHBROW, which sounds like the facial feature.
explanation.definitionFit: The eyebrow is part of the face, one of its features.

clue.text: Black turban out of the lucky dip

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of turban are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: A dark turban is pulled out of a fairground prize barrel.
explanation.walkthrough: A bran tub is a British fairground lucky dip: prizes buried in bran that you rummage for.
explanation.definitionFit: A bran tub is a party game where prizes are fished blindly from a tub, a lucky dip.

clue.text: Current provider of poultry

definitions.meaning: ... hens are poultry kept in rows of cages

explanation.definitionFit: A battery stores electricity, and a battery farm keeps chickens in cramped cages.

clue.text: Stirred into pasta, it makes an appetiser

indicators.note: stirred suggests mixing ingredients, so the letters of into pasta are jumbled

explanation.surface: A cook mixes something into pasta to make a starter.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is the Italian starter course served before the main meal.

clue.text: Skirt issue to get people on side

definitions.meaning: to skirt an issue is to discuss around it without tackling it
to persuade others to agree with you

explanation.definitionFit: Talking round a subject avoids it; talking someone round brings them to your view.

clue.text: Dire fatigue affects posh sailors in contest

indicators.note: in tells us the posh sailors are placed inside the contest

parts.note: a bout is a fight or contest
U means upper-class, posh
RN is the Royal Navy, sailors

explanation.surface: Extreme tiredness strikes upper-class seamen during a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Burnout is severe exhaustion from overwork or stress.

clue.text: Commissioned soldiers in it display emotion

parts.note: commissioned can mean despatched on an errand, sent

indicators.note: in tells us the soldiers go inside it

parts.note: taken as written
men are soldiers, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: Newly commissioned officers show their feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentiment is feeling, a tender emotion.

clue.text: Workman initially lowered in rank

indicators.note: in tells us that letter goes inside the rank

parts.note: a tier is a row or rank, as in seats

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of lowered is used

explanation.surface: A labourer was at first demoted.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiler is a tradesman who lays tiles on roofs or floors.

clue.text: His guarantees are for life

parts.note: reads like a devoted lover's promise, but describes the one who provides a life insurance policy

explanation.definitionFit: An assurer is an insurer, one who issues life assurance policies.

clue.text: Pat and rose could make baskets from it

definitions.note: the definition describes the material: a grass woven into baskets

indicators.note: could make suggests the letters of Pat and rose can be rebuilt into another word

explanation.surface: Two people, Pat and Rose, could weave baskets.
explanation.definitionFit: Esparto is a tough grass of Spain and North Africa used for weaving baskets, ropes and paper.

clue.text: Not a line an actor should discard!

definitions.text: Not a line an actor should discard!

parts.words: Not a line an actor should discard!
parts.note: seems to say an actor must keep every line, but describes a casually delivered line, said as if tossed aside

explanation.definitionFit: A line delivered offhand, deliberately underplayed, is called this in theatre; literally something to be thrown out.

clue.text: Pole brought in to remodel a flag

indicators.note: brought in tells us the pole is put inside the word for remodel

parts.note: to remodel is to redesign
N is the North Pole

explanation.surface: A Polish worker is hired to redesign a banner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a person from Poland but is N, one of the poles. The Red Ensign is the flag flown by British merchant ships.
explanation.definitionFit: The Red Ensign is the British merchant navy flag.

clue.text: Roll up drunk when it's airless?

parts.note: to wind is to roll up, like a clock spring
tight is slang for drunk

explanation.surface: A drunk rolls up a cigarette in a stuffy room.
explanation.definitionFit: Windtight means sealed so no air passes, like airtight.

clue.text: Crouch down despite being dumpy

explanation.definitionFit: Squatting is crouching low, and a squat figure is short and stocky.

clue.text: This poet's new to the French department

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, joining the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: to here means attached, so the new comes after the department

parts.note: the Aude is a department in southern France

explanation.surface: A poet is newly arrived in a French administrative region.
explanation.walkthrough: France is divided into departments; the Aude, round Carcassonne, is one.
explanation.definitionFit: W. H. Auden was an Anglo-American poet of the 20th century.

clue.text: Rating's criminal daughter means to vamoose

parts.note: a rating is an ordinary sailor, an AB (able seaman), here possessive
a con is a convict, a criminal

explanation.surface: A sailor's lawless daughter plans to run away.
explanation.definitionFit: Vamoose is slang for leave in a hurry, as one who absconds does.

clue.text: A saucer for the champion

parts.note: a saucer holds a teacup, while a champion holds a trophy cup

explanation.definitionFit: Both a saucer and a title-holder can be said to have the cup, one literally under it.

clue.text: Beaten for having made stew spicy

definitions.meaning: to curry is an old word for beating, as in currying a horse with a comb
made into a hot dish with Indian spices

explanation.definitionFit: Curried can mean thrashed or groomed with a comb, and also cooked in a hot spiced sauce.

clue.text: Money given in settlement for decisive match

indicators.note: in tells us the money goes inside the settlement

parts.note: a payoff is a settlement of what is owed
L is the pound sign, standing for money

explanation.surface: Cash paid in a settlement decides the match.
explanation.definitionFit: A play-off is an extra game played to settle a tie.

clue.text: Mineral found in non-ersatz fish

parts.note: not ersatz means genuine, real
the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: A mineral turns up inside a genuine fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Realgar is an arsenic sulphide, an orange-red mineral.

clue.text: Politician gets only one-star accommodation

indicators.note: accommodation suggests an arrangement, so the letters of one-star are reorganised

explanation.surface: A politician must make do with a cheap hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: A senator is a member of a senate, a legislator.

clue.text: Flask won in a draw in Morocco

indicators.note: in tells us the draw is placed inside Morocco

parts.note: MA is the international vehicle code for Morocco
to pull is to draw

explanation.surface: Someone wins a flask in a raffle in North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'draw' reads as a raffle but is PULL; 'won' and the second 'in' are only links.
explanation.definitionFit: An ampulla is a small two-handled flask used by the Romans for oil or wine.

clue.text: Games expert has to be calm

parts.note: PE is physical education, school games
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A sports teacher must stay composed.
explanation.definitionFit: Peace is a state of quiet and calm.

clue.text: Boy embraces Irish landowner in Scotland

indicators.note: embraces tells us the boy surrounds the Irish

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A young man hugs an Irish estate owner in the Highlands.
explanation.definitionFit: A laird is a Scottish owner of a landed estate.

clue.text: Outstanding old footballer

parts.note: a wing is a player on the flank in football

explanation.surface: A former football star was excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Outstanding here means unpaid, still due, as a debt is.

clue.text: Excluding Gail is not in order

indicators.note: in order suggests the letters of Gail is not need sorting into the right arrangement

explanation.surface: Leaving Gail out is not proper.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolating means cutting off or keeping apart, shutting out.

clue.text: Not in the contract as specified

indicators.note: in tells us the word not goes inside the contract

parts.note: a deed is a legal contract
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something was absent from the agreement as stated.
explanation.definitionFit: Denoted means indicated or marked out, so specified.

clue.text: Condition rejected by senior sportsman

indicators.note: rejected means the word for condition is turned back

parts.note: if introduces a condition
an elder is a senior person

explanation.surface: Terms are refused by an older athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: A fielder is a player in cricket or baseball who fields the ball.
